subject: Piece of Heart
text: Link can use a Bomb to open a hidden pit in the fenced-in square near the Lake Hylia entrance and buy a Piece of Heart from a Business Scrub for ten rupees.

evidence.quote: Head for the fenced-in square near the entrance to Lake Hylia.  Jump into the middle of the fences, and head for the approximate center.  Use a Bomb to blast open a hidden pit in the middle of the pasture (use the Stone of Agony to find it easier, if you have it.  Buy the Piece of Heart from a Business Scrub down here for a mere ten rupees.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Link can place a bomb near a lone tree north of Lon Lon Ranch to reveal a hidden pit containing a pool with a Piece of Heart at the bottom, reachable with the Steels Boots or Gold Scale.

evidence.quote: Look for a lone tree north of Lon Lon Ranch.  Place a bomb near the tree to reveal a hidden pit (use the Stone of Agony to find it easier, if you have it). Jump into the pit, and kill the Tektite at the bottom.  Either use the Steels Boots or the Gold Scale to go to the bottom of the pool and get the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Returning the small white dog from behind a stall near the Gate in Hyrule Castle Market to the woman in the second door on the left in the back alley rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Look for a small white dog behind a stall near the entrance to the Gate.  Run near it so that it follows you, then enter the back alley near the entrance to the Treasure Chest Game.  Enter the second door on the left and speak with the fat lady inside.  She'll recognize the dog as her own, and reward you with a Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart can be won as a prize by successfully completing all three goals in the Bombchu Bowling Alley.

evidence.quote: Keep playing the Bombchu Bowling Alley game until the Piece of Heart is offered up as a prize...Completing all three goals successfully will win you whatever prize the clerk showed you at the start.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Reaching the last room of the nighttime Treasure Chest Game in Hyrule Castle Market rewards a Piece of Heart from a lone chest.

evidence.quote: Enter the Treasure Chest Game near the entrance to the Back Alley in Hyrule Castle Market (it's only open at night)...When you reach the last room in the minigame, you will find a lone chest which contains a Piece of Heart.

subject: Treasure Chest Game
text: In the Treasure Chest Game, each room contains two chests with either a Small Key or a Rupee booby prize, and the Lens of Truth can be used to see the contents of each chest.

evidence.quote: There are two chests in this room, one of which contains a Small Key, the other of which contains a Rupee.  The Key lets you progress, the rupee is a booby prize.  Normally, you'd have to guess which chest contains the Key.  But the Lens of Truth makes things easier.  Simply use the Lens of Truth to see the contents of each chest, and take the Small Key in each room.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Pushing milk crates in the corner of the grain mill at Lon Lon Ranch reveals a crawl tunnel leading to an empty nest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: In the corner of the mill, there are a large number of milk crates...The X marks where a new tunnel will have appeared.  Crawl through the tunnel to find an empty nest, which houses a Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In Kakariko Village, the opening on the backside of Impa's House can be reached by floating with a Cucco from the unfinished house, riding Kaepora Gaebora from Death Mountain Trail, or using the Hookshot as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: One, as Young Link grab a Cucco and float out to the balcony from the top of the unfinished house.  Two, as Young Link hitch a ride from Kaepora Gaebora on top of Death Mountain Trail.  He'll drop you off on top of Impa's House.  From there, drop down to the opening...Lastly, with Adult Link simply use the Hookshot to get on top of Impa's House, then drop down to the doorway from there.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: The Piece of Heart on the high ledge in the Windmill can be grabbed with the Boomerang as Young Link or reached upon finishing Dampe's Cave Race as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: As Young Link, use the Boomerang to grab the Piece of Heart from the ledge.  Or, with Adult Link you can finish Dampe's Cave Race, which will spit you out right next to the Piece of Heart when you finish.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: As Adult Link, pulling onto the blue roof across from the Windmill and speaking with the man gazing up at Death Mountain rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: As Adult Link, pull yourself up to the blue roof across from the Windmill.  Speak with the man gazing up at Death Mountain, and he'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Link receives a Piece of Heart as a reward from the House of Skulltula upon obtaining fifty Skulltula Tokens.

evidence.quote: Get fifty Skulltula Tokens, then get the Piece of Heart as a reward from the House of Skulltula.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Pulling aside a gravestone in the rear of Kakariko Graveyard reveals a pit where defeating the Redead and playing the Sun's Song spawns a chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Pull aside the Gravestones in the rear of Kakariko Graveyard.  One of them has a pit underneath it.  Drop into this pit, and kill the Redead inside.  Play the Sun's Song, and a chest appears which contains the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: During the Grave Digging Minigame between nightfall and 10:00, paying Dampe 10 rupees to dig dirt patches in Kakariko Graveyard can uncover a Piece of Heart hidden in one of twelve patches.

evidence.quote: From nightfall to 10:00, Dampe will operate a Grave Digging Minigame in the Graveyard...In one of the twelve dirt patches dotted around the graveyard, there is hidden a Piece of Heart.  In order to find the Piece of Heart, stand directly on that dirt patch so that way Dampe will stop directly in front of it, then speak to Dampe and pay him 10 rupees to dig up that patch of dirt.  Most of the dirt patches contain at the very least some rupees.  Keep playing the game until you dig up the Piece of Heart.

subject: Heart-Pounding Grave Digging Tour
text: The Grave Digging Minigame operates only from nightfall to 10:00 and cannot be accessed with the Sun's Song, requiring Link to wait for nightfall in Hyrule Field or Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote: The game only operates from nightfall to 10:00, so you can't use the Sun's Song to access it.  You'll have to return to Hyrule Field or Death Mountain Trail and wait for the wolf's howl that indicates nightfall, then return to Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Planting a Magic Bean in the soft earth on the west side of Kakariko Graveyard allows Adult Link to ride the Magic Leaf up to a ledge crate containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: As Young Link, plant a Magic Bean in the patch of soft earth on the west side of the Graveyard.  Return to the Graveyard as Adult Link, and ride the Magic Leaf up to a high ledge.  Roll into the crate on the ledge to find a Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Completing Dampe's Cave Race underneath the flower-covered gravestone in Kakariko Graveyard in under one minute rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Dampe's Cave Race Game can be found underneath a gravestone on the left side of Kakariko Graveyard.  It's the only gravestone with flowers growing on it.  Drop down the pit underneath the grave...If you make it under one minute, then Dampe will give you a Piece of Heart for your efforts.
